This Motor accidents claims appeal having come up for orders on 10.01.2025, the Court on the same day passed the following:
 P.T.O  C. PRATHEEP KUMAR, J  -----------------------------------------------
 C.M.Appl. No.1 of 2019  in  MACA.No.4637 of 2019  ------------------------------------------------
Dated this the 10th day of January, 2025  ORDER
This is an application filed by the appellants praying for condoning the delay of 178 days in filing the appeal.
2. The application was opposed on the ground that sufficient ground was not stated for condoning the delay.
3. The petitioner filed the above appeal claiming enhancement of compensation in respect of injuries sustained in a motor vehicle accident.

Considering the fact that this appeal related to claim Vilasini Krishnan vs Bajaj Alliance General Insurance ... on 10 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/51845454/
1 for compensation under the provisions of Motor Vehicles Act, I hold that the delay of 178 days in filing the appeal can be condoned on condition that the petitioner shall waive the interest for the enhanced amount of compensation awarded, if any, for the period of delay in filing the appeal.
